General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 65,631.66 acres, which realized $41,971.40. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department, in round numbers, is 495,814.16 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian lands, amounted to $126,950.22, a considerable portion of which is not yet due.
